The name Kiswar carries the meaning “Golden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Kiswar usually hope their child will grow to embody golden and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kiswar holds a deep connection with Islamic culture, as it directly relates to the religious practice of using a kiswah (a cover or drape) to shield the Kaaba, the holiest site in Islam, from public view during certain times of the year. The kiswah is a sign of respect and reverence for this sacred space.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Kiswar also carries spiritual significance, as it is a gentle reminder to keep one's inner self veiled with faith and humility, just as the Kaaba is veiled with the kiswah. It encourages one to cover their weaknesses and imperfections with the cloak of God's mercy and love. The name Kiswar is a reflection of the beauty and majesty of God, and serves as a constant reminder to strive towards attaining His pleasure and nearness.
